description: Agora v1 BFF capability manifest. Lists the 7 agora.*.v1 capabilities and the schemas they are associated with. Frozen as of AG-XR-001; downstream tasks must not rename or remove entries.

capabilities.name: agora.identity.v1
capabilities.description: Operator identity, access scope, and servant (persona) profile surfaces.

capabilities.name: agora.session.v1
capabilities.description: Ask-persona sessions, messages, handoffs, inbox, and SSE channels.

capabilities.name: agora.workshop.v1
capabilities.description: Strategy workshop sessions, completeness assessments, committee sessions, evaluation runs, training examples, and persona-lab runs.

capabilities.name: agora.research.v1
capabilities.description: Research plans, research run summaries, and candidate artifact pools.

capabilities.name: agora.trading.v1
capabilities.description: Trading events (observation-only), trading intents, signal observations, signal feedback, and shadow decisions.
safety_notes: No route in this capability may route live orders.
TradingEvent.no_order_route_proof must be present on all persisted events.

capabilities.name: agora.dashboard.v1
capabilities.description: Dashboard layout recipes, widget specifications, daily briefing, market notes, watchlist, postmortems, decision journal, alerts triage, journal entries, and notes.

capabilities.name: agora.personalization.v1
capabilities.description: Operator personalization events, persona memory, insights, and preference management.
capabilities.writeback_note: PersonalizationEvent.memory_writeback_eligible=true events may trigger operator memory writeback in the persona memory service.
